sources.label: Morphe patches for streaming and news phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops Firebase Analytics, which records what you read, watch, and search for, and stops the app from reading your advertising ID. Push notifications and polls are left alone. Opt-in; test on-device.
Lets the re-signed app start: Google's Pairip license check otherwise blocks any copy not installed from the Play Store. Client-side only; it does not bypass Play Integrity attestation.

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
Hides the promotional buttons you choose in the patch options, such as "Text President Trump". Opt-in; test on-device.
Hides the feeds you choose in the patch options: Truth Social, X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, or the Wire. Opt-in; test on-device.
Removes the app's microphone permission, which no feature in the app uses.

Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot for Tor. If the proxy is not running, the app cannot connect. Web pages shown inside the app do not use the proxy. Opt-in; test on-device.

Hides your mobile carrier from the app and the ad and analytics SDKs inside it, or reports a carrier name you choose. Carrier deals the app detects from your carrier will not work while this is on. Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.
